tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Window and page ground. Everything sits on it; never a lighter page.

tokens.name: bg-2
tokens.usage: Panels, cards, setting tiles at rest, sidebar, search box, inactive tabs.

tokens.name: bg-3
tokens.usage: Raised surface inside a panel: default button fill, choice options, a tile that is on, the left column of a split panel.

tokens.name: bg-4
tokens.usage: Highest step: switch track, empty segments, neutral chip, hovered tile, the current option outline fill. Never a ground for long text.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Titles, numbers, values and active labels. 18:1 on bg, 15:1 on bg-4.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary copy, tile names at rest, inactive tabs, default icon colour. 7.7:1 on bg, 6.4:1 on bg-4.

tokens.name: ink-3
tokens.usage: Small caps labels (label style), units, counters, hints. Exact value from the v5 mockups: 3.9:1 on bg and 3.3:1 on bg-4, below the 4.5:1 floor for 11.5px text. Use only beside a value that carries the meaning; #868690 would pass on every surface.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Default 1px border of panels, tiles and cards, and dividers inside them.

tokens.name: line-2
tokens.usage: Stronger 1px border: buttons, ghost chips, the apply bar, the current option, hovered tiles, dashed add tiles.

tokens.name: red
tokens.usage: Rago red, the one accent. Applied state, main action, active tab, signature block, page-title accent. Text on it is always red-ink. 5.6:1 on bg as text.

tokens.name: red-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons placed on red or on paper. 5.6:1 on red. Never white on red (3.3:1).

tokens.name: red-deep
tokens.usage: Pressed main button and the apply bar button while it works. White text passes on it (5.2:1).

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Live dot (with shadow-live) and measured gains only. Always next to a word or number, never colour alone.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Torn paper tape behind section titles (Section tape). red-ink text on it, 16:1.

tokens.name: pop-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary line inside the light popover (on ink). 8:1.

tokens.name: fx-glass
tokens.usage: Apply bar fill, with a 24px backdrop blur.

tokens.name: fx-carbon
tokens.usage: Carbon effect: 8px stripes every 16px at angle-carbon, faded in from the left over the right 220 to 340px of a panel or bar.

tokens.name: fx-halftone
tokens.usage: Halftone dots, 9px pitch, top-right corner of the window, faded at 225deg.

tokens.name: fx-halftone-on-red
tokens.usage: Halftone dots, 8px pitch, on red blocks (signature block, selected preset).

tokens.name: fx-red-wash
tokens.usage: Start of the left-to-right wash behind the active sidebar item.

tokens.name: fx-hatch
tokens.usage: Pending state: 4px red hatch stripes (with fx-hatch-faint) plus a 1.5px red inset outline.

tokens.name: fx-hatch-faint
tokens.usage: Gaps between the pending hatch stripes.

tokens.name: fx-cover-shade
tokens.usage: Chip placed on a game cover (launcher name), so it reads on any art.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Page title, uppercase, one per page, with the brush stroke under it and an outline echo 14px right and 12px up.

styles.name: num-hero
styles.usage: The one live number in the signature block (ping in ms), red-ink on red.

styles.name: grade
styles.usage: One-word verdict or state (GREAT, ON), uppercase. ON uses 104px.

styles.name: metric
styles.usage: Headline measurements (ping, jitter, loss). Unit at 22px in ink-2.

styles.name: bar-name
styles.usage: Count or profile name at the left of the apply bar, in red.

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: Number in a stat tile, unit at 20px in ink-2.

styles.name: card-title
styles.usage: Title of a profile card or panel, uppercase. Panel titles in Network test use 34px.

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: Section title, uppercase, set on the paper tape.

styles.name: preset
styles.usage: Preset card name and numeric choice options (1, 2, 3, 4).

styles.name: nav
styles.usage: Sidebar items, uppercase.

styles.name: btn-lg
styles.usage: Large button label, uppercase.

styles.name: btn
styles.usage: Button label, uppercase. The apply bar button uses 18px.

styles.name: btn-sm
styles.usage: Small button label, uppercase.

styles.name: tile-name
styles.usage: Setting tile name, uppercase, ink-2 at rest and ink when on or pending.

styles.name: option
styles.usage: Choice option label, uppercase.

styles.name: tab
styles.usage: Tab label, uppercase.

styles.name: kick
styles.sample: NETWORK // PING, STABILITY AND HIT REGISTRATION
styles.usage: Line above the page title, uppercase, ink-2, the // in red.

styles.name: chip
styles.usage: Chip label, uppercase.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Small caps label over a value, uppercase, ink-3.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default sentence text, sentence case, ink or ink-2.

styles.name: pop
styles.sample: Tunes Windows TCP/IP so small game packets leave sooner.
styles.usage: Popover text, bg on ink.

styles.name: sub
styles.usage: One-line helper under a title or button, ink-2.

spacing.note: Values taken from the v5 mockups (1440 x 900 window). Content column starts 40px right of the 236px sidebar.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between segments and spark bars.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between tabs.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between choice options.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between setting tiles; gap inside chips and buttons.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Gap between cards in a row (presets, games, stat tiles).

tokens.name: space-14
tokens.usage: Gap between panels in a row; tile and option inner padding.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Section title to its content.

tokens.name: space-22
tokens.usage: Panel padding (top and sides).

tokens.name: space-26
tokens.usage: Large panel padding; top bar to page head.

tokens.name: space-40
tokens.usage: Between sections; main column side padding.

radius.note: The validated direction is the rounded variant: corners grow with the size of the element.

tokens.name: radius-seg
tokens.usage: Segments of a segment bar.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Switch knob, keyboard hint, popover badges.

tokens.name: radius-chip
tokens.usage: Chips and the switch track; the preset check badge.

tokens.name: radius-btn-sm
tokens.usage: Small buttons.

tokens.name: radius-tab
tokens.usage: Tabs and sidebar items.

tokens.name: radius-option
tokens.usage: Choice options inside a profile card.

tokens.name: radius-btn
tokens.usage: Buttons, search box, top bar stats.

tokens.name: radius-tile
tokens.usage: Setting tiles, popover, input boxes, diagram nodes.

tokens.name: radius-btn-lg
tokens.usage: Large buttons, sidebar PC card.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Preset cards, game cards, stat tiles.

tokens.name: radius-bar
tokens.usage: Apply bar, profile cards.

tokens.name: radius-panel

tokens.name: shadow-glow
tokens.usage: Red glow under a red button only.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Apply bar floating over the page.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: Hover popover.

tokens.name: shadow-selected
tokens.usage: Selected game card (with a red border).

tokens.name: shadow-live
tokens.usage: Glow of the green live dot.

angle.note: The skew is the brand's signature cut: buttons, tabs, switches, segments and red blocks lean by it.

tokens.name: angle-skew
tokens.usage: skewX of buttons, tabs, options, switches, segments, the signature block and the preset check.

tokens.name: angle-carbon
tokens.usage: Direction of the carbon stripes and of the pending hatch.

tokens.name: angle-tape
tokens.usage: Rotation of the paper tape behind section titles.

tokens.name: angle-brush
tokens.usage: Rotation of the red brush stroke under the page title.

tokens.name: size-chip

tokens.name: size-field

tokens.name: size-bar
